target_customer: Global and non-US founders who want to incorporate and run a US company, plus a few dozen B2B enterprise clients
problem: Non-US founders find US incorporation, registered agent service, compliance, bookkeeping and tax filing fragmented and hard to do remotely.
business_model: Fee per incorporation plus recurring compliance, registered agent, bookkeeping and tax subscriptions; B2B partner deals
product_category: Company formation and compliance platform (startup operating system)

founders.name: Mark Milastsivy
founders.background_notes: YC page and company pages list no background; none found in opened sources.

competitors.name: Stripe Atlas
competitors.what: Flat fee Delaware incorporation bundle with bank account and Stripe setup

competitors.name: Clerky
competitors.what: Delaware C corp incorporation and startup legal paperwork

technical_complexity.rationale: Workflow software that automates filings and integrates registered agent, banking and tax partners; operational and compliance work outweighed engineering difficulty.

defensibility.rationale: It owns registered agent entities in all 50 states per its launch post, which creates recurring customers, but incorporation itself is easy to copy and many rivals exist.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents kept their offerings; Firstbase was itself acquired by Harbor Compliance in December 2025.

market_need_then: Remote and international founders were forming US companies in growing numbers; Firstbase reported about 6,000 incorporations by July 2021 across founders from 170 countries.

branding.domain_note: Operates on firstbase.io; the exact .com firstbase.com belongs to an unrelated remote hardware company.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, confident and founder centric, with short benefit led headlines

branding.brand_signature: The claim that firstbase.io is what founders type when they think about incorporating
branding.community_and_virality: Appears on Stripe Atlas comparison pages and Product Hunt; no merch or fan content found.

brand_strength.rationale: Name is confusable with an unrelated Firstbase (remote equipment, later bought by AppDirect) which raised a16z funding; the brand has comparison page presence but no distinctive assets found.

outcome_analysis: Firstbase grew from incorporation into a compliance and bookkeeping suite, reaching about 15,000 compliance customers by its YC launch post and over 30,000 incorporations per its about page. It raised a small $3M seed in 2021 and was acquired by Harbor Compliance in December 2025, which looks like a modest outcome rather than a breakout. Terms were not disclosed.
notes: Directory status says Active but a Harbor Compliance press release dated 2025-12-10 reports the acquisition (the Harbor page itself was not opened; the date and deal come from search results, including mergerlinks). Competitor sources are undated comparison pages; Stripe Atlas and Clerky existed before the batch. Other Firstbase companies (AppDirect acquired one; a16z funded a remote hardware one) are unrelated and were excluded. No second source for the seed was found.
